name: Deep Research
tagline: Multi-source research with citation tracking, evidence persistence, and structured report generation.
description: Comprehensive research skill for delivering citation-tracked research reports through a structured pipeline. Includes evidence persistence, source identity management, claim-level verification, and progressive context management. Supports four research modes: quick (3 phases, 2-5 min), standard (6 phases, 5-10 min), deep (8 phases, 10-20 min), and ultradeep (8+ phases, 20-45 min). Generates professional reports with Executive Summary, Introduction, Main Analysis, Synthesis, Limitations, Recommendations, and complete Bibliography. Outputs Markdown, HTML (McKinsey style), PDF, and structured data files (sources.jsonl, evidence.jsonl, claims.jsonl).
